title: Length of the Lifted Literal List
statement: Let $n$ and $a$ be natural numbers, and let $T$ be a term on $n$ coordinates whose literals have pairwise distinct coordinates. The list obtained by lifting the literals of $T$ to the enlarged coordinate set of size $n+a$ has length equal to the width of $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ and the auxiliary coordinate count $a$ are natural numbers
The coordinates of the literals in $T$ are pairwise distinct
